d:
James Harden put up 32 points, 5 three-pointers and 4 assists at Madison Square Garden as the Cavaliers beat the Knicks, 115-107!
With 345 career 30-point games, Harden tied Allen Iverson for the 11th-most in NBA history, behind Dominique Wilkins (346). At 37 years, 77 days old, he also became the oldest player in Cavaliers history to score 30 points in a game, passing Kyle Korver (36 years, 329 days).
